{{Translated title|rom}} :''For the TCG expansion with the set code MEG, see [[Mega Evolution (TCG)]].'' [[File:Meg.png|thumb|250px|Meg]] (Japanese: '''メグ''' ''Meg'') is the main character of [[PT14]]. She is allergic to {{cat|powder and spore moves}}. ==History== Meg decided to travel to her family's [[Safari Zone]] for her summer vacation. There, she quickly encountered a {{p|Chansey}} wearing a hat, who was being chased down by her uncle [[Bozly]]. When asked, he refused to talk much about Chansey, only saying she was a local troublemaker, but Meg had her doubts, especially after seeing her cure the {{status|paralysis}} of a {{pkmn2|wild}} {{p|Dratini}} with her {{m|Heal Bell}}. After pressing a bit more, Bozly conceded and told Meg that Chansey used to belong to the previous Safari Zone warden, Meg's grandfather, and that she stole his hat once he took over his father's mantle. One day, she told her uncle about her allergy after he unknowingly triggered it by simply mentioning the [[move]] {{m|Rage Powder}}. This seemed to give him an idea, and he asked her if she wanted to tag along. They visited an area densily populated by {{p|Hoppip}}, {{p|Skiploom}}, and {{p|Jumpluff}}, who Bozly theorized could be responsible for the weird things happening at the Safari Zone lately, such as the paralyzed Dratini. Suddenly, a Hoppip used {{m|Stun Spore}} to paralyze Bozly's {{p|Maschiff}}, but the status condition was quickly cured by Chansey. Seeing how misguided he was, Bozly apologized to Chansey, and she returned his hat. Some time later, Meg's summer vacation ended, and she was picked up by her mother. In the car, she discovered that Chansey had managed to shrink down and sneak into her bag. ==Pokémon== ===Befriended=== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Safari Zone warden |pkmn=Chansey |gender=female |type1=Normal |img=Safari Zone Warden Chansey PT.png |cap=Safari Zone warden's Chansey |epnum=PT14 |epname= |vajp= |desc={{p|Chansey}} is a Pokémon that belonged to Meg's grandfather, the previous warden of the [[Safari Zone]]. She is quite known at the Safari Zone due to the hat she uses, which used to be her Trainer's. The hat was supposed to be inherited by [[Bozly]], but Chansey took it and ran off, leading him to think she is a troublemaker, when, in fact, she was also helping to keep the order at the Safari Zone. After the situation was cleared up, she returned the hat to Bozly. Later, while going home, Meg discovered that Chansey managed to shrink down and sneak into her bag.
